_doc: Hand edits per clip for engine/render_v2.py. segments.<index>: start/end (lock an edge, master s), cuts [[a,b]] (remove exact master ranges, no pads), mics auto|both|host. shots: split_at / cutaway_at (OUTPUT seconds), no_cutaway [[a,b]] (output s), splits (target count). word_fixes: token-level caption corrections applied before line breaking (captions_v2.apply_word_fixes) where the transcript misses or mishears words the audio has. drop_backchannel: the guest's lone 'yeah' is not captioned. shots.force_frames: [[f0, f1, kind R|C|S|H, look, why], ...] OUTPUT frames tiling the clip: a hand shot list that replaces the automatic plan. caption_patches: hand fixes on the finished caption lines: replace [[old, new]], merge_next [[line, new text]], drop_into_next_once [line].
